name: ecommerce-website
description: Fashion e-commerce site with a chosen stack; the plan must cover accounts, catalogue, checkout, admin, and the note about discount codes.

configuration.name: Atelier Commerce
configuration.description: Premium fashion e-commerce storefront with curated collections, cart, and checkout.

notes: Support percentage and fixed-amount discount codes at checkout.

output.summary: A Next.js storefront for curated fashion collections with accounts, a cart, hosted checkout, discount codes, and an admin dashboard for catalogue and order management.

requirements.statement: Shoppers can create an account and sign in.
Shoppers can browse collections and product detail pages.
Shoppers can add items to a cart and pay through a hosted payment checkout.
Shoppers can apply percentage or fixed-amount discount codes at checkout.
Staff can manage products, collections, discount codes, and orders in an admin dashboard.
Product pages are server-rendered for search engines.

assumptions: Payments use a PCI-compliant hosted checkout so card data never touches our servers.

open_questions.question: Which payment provider should checkout use?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Determines the checkout integration and supported payment methods.

open_questions.question: Can discount codes be combined on one order?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Changes discount validation rules and order totals.

tasks.title: Data model and migrations
tasks.description: Users, products, collections, carts, orders, and discount codes in PostgreSQL.
